title: [GAP-4] Space and channel lifecycle undefined beyond "the owner may transfer or delete"
description: Review finding GAP-4: Space and channel lifecycle undefined beyond "the owner may transfer or delete" (lens GAP). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:12; spec/03-spaces.md:49, 51-128, 131; spec/08-cross-space.md:22. Fix: As proposed. Grep confirms there is no deletion record, no archival state, no rename text and no genesis contents. Two additions. `channelCID` is used as the exporter context for the token, access key and sealing key (05:194, 202, 218), but no text defines what it hashes, so channel rename and move are undefined at the crypto layer too. Space state has no admin list or role-assignment field, though 03:131 makes "an admin authorized under the prior state" the S4 validation rule. The §3.5 fix must add both fields (`admins` and member-to-role assignments). Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
